title: Python Documentation Now Available in Russian
summary: The official Python documentation has been translated into Russian, expanding accessibility for Russian-speaking developers. The translation was made possible by community contributions, and the project welcomes further volunteer efforts to maintain and expand translations into other languages.
key_points: The Python documentation is now available in Russian, thanks to community contributions.
This effort aims to make Python more accessible to Russian-speaking developers worldwide.
The translation project relies on volunteers to maintain accuracy and update content.
Python’s documentation is available in multiple languages, with ongoing needs for contributors.
Interested individuals can participate by following the translation guide in the Python Developer’s Guide or using the Translation dashboard.
